subject: a 14th-century West African Mande emperor of about forty-five with dark skin and a short neat beard, wearing flowing layered robes of white and indigo cotton with gold embroidery, a white turban, simple gold ornaments, calm dignified expression

panels.01-mansa: {S}, younger, standing on a riverbank in the West African savanna in 1312, watching wooden boats with sails head out toward a distant grey sea, courtiers and drummers behind him, baobab trees, thoughtful and uncertain mood, 14th century Mali
panels.02-caravan: a vast camel caravan crossing golden Sahara dunes in 1324, {S} riding at its centre under a large parasol, rows of attendants in brocade and silk robes, camels carrying leather bags, sunrise, epic wide shot, 14th century
panels.03-pyramids: the pilgrim camp of {S} beside the Pyramids of Giza in July 1324, many tents and camels, travellers resting, the Nile and palm trees in the distance, warm evening light, Mamluk Egypt, 14th century
panels.04-cairo: {S} standing upright with quiet dignity in the grand columned audience hall of the Mamluk sultan in Cairo in 1324, the seated sultan in a Mamluk turban rising to greet him, courtiers and an interpreter, carved wooden screens and lamps, formal and respectful, 14th century Egypt
panels.05-scholar: {S} seated on cushions in a tent at a pilgrim camp in 1324, deep in friendly conversation with an Andalusian poet-scholar in a turban and robe who holds a book, oil lamp, other scholars listening, warm and intellectual mood, no holy buildings shown, 14th century
panels.06-hall: {S} watching builders raise a square plastered audience hall with a dome in a West African royal town in 1325, an Andalusian scholar pointing at a plan, workers mixing plaster and painting bright arabesques, savanna landscape, 14th century Mali
panels.07-mosque: the earthen Djinguereber mosque in Timbuktu being built around 1327, workers carrying mud bricks and palm-wood beams, a stepped mud minaret rising, {S} inspecting the work with scholars beside him, Sahel light, 14th century West Africa
panels.08-atlas: a mapmaker in a 14th-century Majorcan workshop in 1375 painting a large parchment map of Africa with gold leaf, the small figure of a seated West African king holding a gold nugget on the map, brushes and compasses, warm window light, no readable text
